whatGoesOut: Only one question goes out: a request to {host} for the newest release of {app}, without names, contents, settings or the version of this server.
noOtherCalls: Apart from that {app} calls nobody by itself.
setupHint: Once a day {app} asks {host} whether a newer version is out and tells you in the bell. You can change this later under Settings › About {app}.
setupHintNoBell: When you open Settings › About {app}, {app} asks {host} at most once a day whether a newer version is out and shows it there. You can change this later under Settings › About {app}.
setupHintDevices: When you open Settings › About {app}, {app} asks {host} at most once a day whether a newer version is out and shows it there; also once a day while a device of an operator wants to hear of new versions. You can change this later under Settings › About {app}.
dailyHintNoBell: Asks {host} when an operator opens this page, at most once a day. Off: only when you press the button.
dailyHintDevices: Asks {host} when an operator opens this page, and once a day while a device of an operator wants to hear of new versions. Off: only when you press the button.
failed: That did not work just now. Try again in a moment.
